relevance_note: Case report of a neonate with HA20 caused by a deletion including TNFAIP3 ('revealed a heterozygous 5.15 Mb deletion in 6q23.3q24.3'), plus a table of 11 previously published 6q-deletion patients.
method_note: Case report of one neonate (Patient 1) plus a literature table (Table 1, patients as columns; column header row 'Patient 1'..'Patient 12', source row 'Current report', 'Endo et al.' ...). Patients 2-12 are previously published (refs [13-20]); their source cell is copied to source_reference_in_review. A Python script transcribed Table 1 cells and built column spans; output checked against the table by hand. Table symbols: '+' read as present; '-' is not defined in the legend, so '-' cells are not reported (no exclusions from the table); 'Not mentioned' is not reported. Table 'Fever' (+) is recorded as the feature 'Fever' but not as checklist 'recurrent fever' for Patients 2-12 (recurrence not stated per person; the text's 'in seven patients ... recurrent episodes of fever' is a count without names). Inheritance: Table 1 says 'de novo' for Patients 1, 4, 5, 6, 11 without any description of parental testing, so inheritance is 'not reported' (rule 8) and the cell is kept in parental_testing_statement; 'paternal' (Patient 2) and 'maternal' (Patient 7) recorded as inherited paternal/maternal. Variant strings for Patients 2-12 are only the printed deletion sizes; variant type 'large deletion/CNV' from the named group statements about these deletions (refs [13-20]); zygosity not stated per literature patient. Fig. 2 caption calls the deletions 'pathogenic' generally; not used as a per-variant classification. Contradiction: text gives Patient 1's deletion as '6q23.3q24.3' but Fig. 1 legend says '6q23.2q24.3 region'; the text string is recorded. Patient 1: TORCH serology reported normal while mNGS/PCR found CMV DNA in serum; TORCH exclusion not recorded, CMV DNA recorded observed. Discussion says the fever was 'associated with no apparently infectious manifestation' (not recorded as an exclusion given the CMV finding). Normal ophthalmologic, hearing and brain MRI assessments and abdominal ultrasound recorded only as whole investigations (no uveitis/CNS exclusion). Routine urine and feces tests normal were not recorded as features. Patient 1's anemia: authors state it was not iron-deficiency or AIHA, and DAT negative; checklist 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' left not reported (narrower absence). Age at last evaluation for Patient 1 taken as six months (last described follow-up exam; later follow-up suspended). Patient 5's Anemia cell reads 'HLH' (recorded as HLH observed). Henoch-Schönlein purpura (Patient 9) mapped to checklist vasculitis; Rosacea (Patient 10) to skin lesions; Gastroenteritis (Patient 4) to GI inflammation; 'Respiratory- infections'/'Infections' (Patients 4, 11) to recurrent infections. Text gives counts ('eigtht were female', 'five presented with de novo deletions') consistent with the table; Table 1 shows 8 females and 5 de novo entries.
